content.text: {"findings":[],"floor_verdicts":[{"id":"F1","keep":true,"note":"The default Gemini model (gemini-2.0-flash-lite) is set in settings, the provider class and the agent provider, so anyone who hasn't picked a model sends a request to a model Google has shut down. Change the default to gemini-3.1-flash-lite in all four places and add the replacement to the picker list in defaultModels.js; the retired preview ids there should come off it.","effort":"Hours","not_live":[],"not_gains":[]},{"id":"F2","keep":true,"note":"These ids are in the Gemini picker list, and gemini-3.1-flash-image is the default for image generation, so those requests go to a model that is deprecated. Move the image default to gemini-nano-banana-2.1 and put the successors on the picker list.","effort":"Hours","not_live":[],"not_gains":[]},{"id":"F3","keep":true,"note":"whisper-1 is the hard-coded model in the collector's OpenAI transcription and the default for server-side speech-to-text, and the picker offers the other two retiring models. Move to gpt-transcribe, which OpenAI's lever names for recorded audio, and update the picker list. Check the transcription calls, since the new models take a languages list instead of the single language field.","effort":"A day","not_live":[],"not_gains":[]},{"id":"F4","keep":true,"note":"OpenAI text-to-speech is hard-coded to tts-1, so voice replies will fail once it shuts down. The named successor, gpt-realtime-2.1-mini, is a Realtime API model, so this is a code change rather than an id swap.","effort":"A day or more","not_live":[],"not_gains":[]},{"id":"F5","keep":false,"note":"The openai client is an ordinary library that works here, and nothing in the code shows a problem with the pinned version. The release notes listed are about WebSocket credentials, AWS credentials and transcript grouping, none of which this code uses.","effort":"A day","not_live":[],"not_gains":[{"text":"refresh credentials on WebSocket reconnects (7.26.0)","why":"server/utils/helpers/customModels.js:340 says the Realtime WebSocket API isn't used; the code only calls the REST audio transcription endpoint."},{"text":"cancel requests awaiting AWS credentials (7.11.0)","why":"AWS Bedrock has its own provider code in server/utils/AiProviders/bedrock/anthropicChat.js, and the openai client is not used for it."},{"text":"prevent hangs on fractional transcript grouping deadlines (7.24.0)","why":"Nothing in the code shown uses transcript grouping; server/utils/SpeechToText/groq/index.js:27 only calls audio.transcriptions.create."}]}],"watching":[],"held_back":[]}
